title: Tamsin and the Trail
author: Mara Thackeray
blurb: Wren Vane, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent fifteen years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
